goal: P0 foundation for autonomous Summon Engine V2: establish one explicit SummonScout runtime API/state surface and close the remaining unowned CHAT_MSG_SYSTEM join path without changing Ritual, payment, advert or native execution behavior.
notes: P0.1 is intentionally behavior-conservative. A final TOC compatibility module resolves the legacy core EventAPI/state once, exports W112_SUMMONSCOUT_API_V1/W112_SUMMONSCOUT_STATE, and wraps the current OnEvent chain so an unowned CHAT_MSG_SYSTEM party/raid join temporarily suppresses partyAutoSummon for that dispatch. Existing owned invite markers, grouped/combat resume, Ritual/native bridge, payment, adverts and coordinator behavior are unchanged. Follow-up P0.2 will migrate legacy hot modules to the explicit API and remove their duplicated upvalue discovery; P0.3 will move the public surface into canonical core and reduce semantic package transforms.
